prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice
prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant increase in incurred claims and movement in ultimate estimates leading to strengthened reserves for 2013 and prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate strengthened its gross claims reserves by GBP 27.071m in the year, primarily driven by adverse development on older years (notably 2013 and prior) arising mainly from professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice business. The consulting actuary moved the ultimate claims materially higher (c.GBP 26.7m gross) and a large loss load / IBNR recalibration was introduced; late reporting on personal accident also contributed. The overall movement is therefore an adverse prior-year strengthening concentrated in Professional Lines (and some Accident & Health exposure).
raw_causal_phrases: the deterioration that arose on the 2013 and prior years of account on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business which represent the vast majority of the Syndicate's business and reserves.

The movement is largely caused by the significant increase in the incurred claims position on individual claims of GBP 16.5m gross and GBP 13.4m net with the Syndicate's consulting actuary, Lane Clark & Peacock (LCP), moving the ultimate claims position out by GBP 26.7m gross and GBP 18.6m net as a consequence.
Late reporting on the personal accident account also caused the incurred position to move by some GBP 3.2m.

LCP therefore considered not only the movement in incurred and the materialisation of a number of large losses but also the potential claims universe, setting up a large loss load accordingly as part of the ultimate claims position.
During the year there was net adverse claims development of GBP 18.1 million on the 2013 and prior years, GBP 3.4 million on the 2014 year and GBP 0.2 million on the 2015 year of account.
claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development taken from the 'Changes for prior years' (gross) line in Technical Provisions (Note 17) = GBP 27,071k gross. The report also quotes net adverse development figures (e.g. net GBP 18.1m on 2013 & prior) and detailed components (LCP movement GBP 26.7m gross) - both were cross-checked. A gross claims development triangle is present (gross, in GBP 000) and was used for verification; no individually named catastrophe events were listed. All monetary conversions to millions were performed (1000).
